recorded_by: Claude Code parent agent. Catalog metadata and HTTP HEAD requests only. No imagery bytes were transferred. Not independently checked.

probes.question: Which Earth Search collections hold Level-2A items for June 2017 over a southeastern US box?
probes.method: GET STAC search, bbox -84,30,-80,34, datetime 2017-06-01 to 2017-06-30, limit 1, one request per collection
probes.limits: One month, one box. Says nothing about other regions or months.

probes.question: Does the Earth Search Collection 1 collection hold items in the gap periods its README named as of April 2024?
probes.method: GET STAC search on sentinel-2-c1-l2a, same box, June 2019 and June 2022, limit 1
probes.limits: One month per period, one box. The 2019 gap named in April 2024 is filled for this sample. The 2022 gap persists for this sample.

probes.question: What temporal extent and description do the three Earth Search Level-2A collections declare?

result.sentinel-2-pre-c1-l2a_description: Sentinel-2 Pre-Collection 1 Level-2A (baseline < 05.00), with data and metadata matching collection sentinel-2-c1-l2a

probes.limits: A declared extent is not archive completeness. PR-01 shows an empty month inside the declared extent.

probes.question: Do the Sinergise buckets answer unsigned requests, which requester-pays buckets refuse?
probes.method: HTTP HEAD without credentials on one metadata object and one imagery object per bucket. Headers only. No bytes transferred.
probes.limits: One object of each kind on one date. A 200 to an unsigned HEAD means the object is anonymously readable at that moment. It does not establish a policy for every prefix or date.
